description: SFLOW semi-implicit (A 226 1, theta 0.55, dt 30 s) wind setup in a closed 1D basin 10 km, h = 10 m, implicit Manning friction: uniform U10 20 m/s along x (W 200 1), Garratt drag, ramp 1800 s (W 204). Toward the steady setup d(eta)/dx = tau/(rho g (h + eta)) (validated in Dropbox Storm Surge/validation/01_wind_setup).
